parameters.content:
## 1 · Config & batch
Manual trigger reads every `lead_engine_config` row and folds it into one config object. Read the full `leads` table (for the per-city review median) and the `status = raw` slice, then cap the working batch at `classifier.batchSize` (25).

## 2 · Facts & presence
Per lead: parse reviews + signals, count reviews inside the velocity window, compare against the city median to flag low review velocity.

## 3 · Website + email scrape
Leads with a website: fetch root + configured paths (15s timeout, continue on error), mark `websiteAlive` on a 2xx/3xx root, and harvest emails from mailto: links and text. Leads with no website skip through.

## 4 · LLM classifier
Build one Anthropic Messages request per lead (Haiku, three rubrics, strict-JSON verdict), call the API, then parse the verdict and enforce verbatim-quote evidence on HOT (downgrade to WARM if none survives).

## 5 · Entity check, routing & discard
HOT/WARM go to Companies House: search, token-overlap match on an active ltd/llp, then pull active directors/members for the owner name → route EMAIL. No match routes to the config default. DISCARD/ERROR skip straight to their row update.

## 6 · Email finalise + persist
Pick the best email (site scrape first, else CH-pattern candidate). Verification is live: MillionVerifier checks each candidate email (flag-gated by `verification.enabled`) and a confirmed match becomes the final `email`/`email_status`. Leads with no candidates, a DM route, or verification disabled bypass the API call and keep their originally chosen email untouched. The full scored verdict is then written back to the `leads` row.
